title: Block middle layer
statement: For each natural number $m$, form the list of input-coordinate sets associated to the clauses of the parity CNF on $m$ variables. Its entries are finite subsets of a coordinate set of size $m2^{2m}$.
caveat: The construction depends on the upstream parity-CNF and clause-to-input definitions, whose meanings are not included in the supplied definitions.
